concepts.def: ΔG = ΔH − TΔS; reaction is feasible (spontaneous) when ΔG < 0.
Change in disorder of a system; positive for gas-producing reactions and dissolution.
Reactions with negative ΔS become less feasible at higher T; with positive ΔS more feasible.
Free energy change with all species in standard states; ΔG° = −RT ln K.
ΔG = 0 at equilibrium; the reaction has reached the position of no net change.
